Name: Saku's Little Store
Author: RaffieJohn
Description:
Saku has been stealing some things from Pierre and Joja, and somehow made a shop?!

Who is Saku?

What is Saku?

Why does Saku have a store?



I was inspired by CopperSuns [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9601]Joja Clearance Bin[/url]! Check out her mods﻿, they're great!

COMPATIBILITY:
[list]
[*]It works with SVE and RSV though if you install it mid-game a tree will spawn behind the counter. You can still access the store, but it'll look like the tree is maintaining the shop, instead of Saku.
[/list]KNOWN ISSUES:
[list]
[*]I may have missed a code somewhere, but if you use cjb cheats to forward time, Saku's portrait won't show unless you reload the mod.
[/list]
Credits:
I want to thank [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/fellowclown/about-me]Fellowclown[/url] for allowing me to use his Red-Capped Zuzu portrait for Saku. He also created Saku's sprites! I highly suggest you check out his mods!
I also want to thank[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/CopperSun/about-me] CopperSun[/url] again for inspiring me to make this mod.
Thank you [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/shekurika/about-me]Shekurika[/url] for helping me get the closed message to work!
